title: Simulation 3D Radar Data Generator
text: Generate radar sensor detections and tracks, 3 outputs, {Coordinate frame used to report detections} sets Coordinate system of reported detections; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Coordinate system}, {Mounting location} sets the sensor mounting location, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z]} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw]} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Enable elevation angle measurements} enables radar to measure target elevation, {Enable range rate measurements} enables radar to measure target range rates, {Add measurement noise to observations} enables addition of noise to radar sensor, {Enable generation of reports from false observations} enables creating false alarm radar, {Maximum number of target reports} sets the maximum number of detections or tracks, {Format of generated target reports}, {Azimuthal resolution (deg)} sets the azimuth resolution of radar, {Elevation resolution (deg)} sets the elevation resolution of radar, {Range resolution (m)} sets the range resolution of radar, {Range rate resolution (m/s)} sets the range rate resolution of radar, {Azimuth bias fraction}, {Elevation bias fraction}, {Range bias fraction}, {Range rate bias fraction}, {Total angular field of view [AZ, EL] (deg)} sets the angular field of view of radar, {Range limits [MIN, MAX] (m)} sets the minimum and maximum range of radar, {Range rate limits [MIN, MAX] (m/s)} sets the minimum and maximum range rate of radar, {Detection probability} sets the probability of detecting a target, {False alarm rate} sets the false alarm report, {Reference target range (m)} sets the reference range for given probability, {Reference target RCS (dBsm)} sets the reference radar cross-section for given probability, {Center frequency (Hz)} sets the center frequency of radar, {Select method to specify initial seed} sets the method to specify random number generator seed, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed and {Actor types to oversample} sets the actor type for improved target detection Simulation 3D. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: Unique sensor identifier 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Coordinate system
params.values: Coordinate system for actor transformation Default (default) | MATLAB | ISO8855 | AERO | VRML | SAE

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default)

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z]
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw]
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Enable elevation angle measurements
params.values: Enable radar to measure target elevation angles on (default) | off

params.name: Enable range rate measurements
params.values: Enable radar to measure target range rates on (default) | off

params.name: Add measurement noise to observations
params.values: Enable addition of noise to radar sensor measurements on (default) | off

params.name: Enable generation of reports from false observations
params.values: Enable creating false alarm radar detections on (default) | off

params.name: Maximum number of target reports
params.values: Maximum number of detections or tracks 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Format of generated target reports
params.values: Format of generated target reports Clustered detections (default) | Tracks | Detections

params.name: Coordinate frame used to report detections
params.values: Coordinate system of reported detections Body (default) | Sensor rectangular | Sensor spherical

params.name: Azimuthal resolution (deg)
params.values: Azimuth resolution of radar 4 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Elevation resolution (deg)
params.values: Elevation resolution of radar 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Range resolution (m)
params.values: Range resolution of radar 2.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Range rate resolution (m/s)
params.values: Range rate resolution of radar 0.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Azimuth bias fraction
params.values: Azimuth bias fraction of radar 0.1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Elevation bias fraction
params.values: Elevation bias fraction of radar 0.1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Range bias fraction
params.values: Range bias fraction 0.05 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Range rate bias fraction
params.values: Range rate bias fraction 0.05 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Total angular field of view [AZ, EL] (deg)
params.values: Angular field of view of radar [20 5] (default) | 1-by-2 positive real-valued vector of form [azfov,elfov]

params.name: Range limits [MIN, MAX] (m)
params.values: Minimum and maximum range of radar [0 150] (default) | 1-by-2 nonnegative real-valued vector of form [min max]

params.name: Range rate limits [MIN, MAX] (m/s)
params.values: Minimum and maximum range rate of radar (m/s) [-100 100] (default) | 1-by-2 real-valued vector of form [min max]

params.name: Detection probability
params.values: Probability of detecting a target 0.9 (default) | scalar in range (0, 1]

params.name: False alarm rate
params.values: False alarm report rate 1e-06 (default) | positive real scalar in range [10 –7, 10 –3 ]

params.name: Reference target range (m)
params.values: Reference range for given probability of detection 100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Reference target RCS (dBsm)
params.values: Reference radar cross-section for given probability of detection 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Center frequency (Hz)
params.values: Center frequency of radar band 77e9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Select method to specify initial seed
params.values: Method to specify random number generator seed Repeatable (default) | Specify seed | Not repeatable

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Random number generator seed 0 (default) | nonnegative integer less than 2 32

params.name: Actor types to oversample
params.values: Actor type for improved target detection Simulation 3D Vehicles (default) | None | Simulation 3D Actors | All Actors
